summary: You have delivered an outstanding, professional-grade space mission design report for ZYZZsat. Your technical analyses effectively integrate first-principles orbital mechanics, STK simulation verification, and realistic engineering trade-offs. The report thoroughly details operational context, launch options, and EOL disposal. To elevate your work to industry-standard rigor, ensure rotational corrections are incorporated into launch azimuth derivations and include quantitative RF link budgets alongside your data volume sizing.
next_steps: Refine the launch trajectory calculation in Section 2.2 by incorporating Earth's eastward tangential rotational velocity to convert the inertial burnout azimuth into a topocentric launch azimuth.
Develop and include a quantitative RF link budget in Section 2.4 evaluating carrier frequencies, transmitter power, antenna gains, and path losses for the 50 Mbit/s X-band downlink and S-band TT&C.
Quantify the technical risk mitigations identified in Section 3 by defining concrete performance thresholds and mass/cost margin allocations for the secondary Falcon 9 rideshare option.

criteria.C1: You achieved the Accomplished level by thoroughly presenting ZYZZsat's coral bleaching monitoring mission in Section 1. You clearly justified using a single microsatellite and accurately identified operational users (AIMS) and customer stakeholders (GBRMPA, CSIRO, BoM) using strong literature backing. To maintain this high standard, continue detailing how operational stakeholder requirements directly constrain design parameters.
criteria.C2: You achieved the Accomplished level with comprehensive orbital derivations, STK analyses, and drag-sail decay modeling across Section 2. To refine your technical rigor further, correct your topocentric launch azimuth in Section 2.2 by accounting for Earth's eastward tangential velocity, and incorporate quantitative RF link budgets in Section 2.4 for the 50 Mbit/s X-band downlink and S-band TT&C.
criteria.C3: You reached the Accomplished level in Section 3 by providing an honest, rigorous engineering evaluation of system limitations alongside key metrics. You critically addressed launch readiness risks (Vega C fallback), fluid lensing scaling, and revisit cadences. To build on this standard in future professional reports, pair identified technical risks directly with quantified mitigation budgets or operational margins.
criteria.C4: You attained the Accomplished level with exceptional engineering report structure and clarity. The executive summary, MATLAB/STK figures, and data tables (e.g., Table 4) are well integrated, supported by consistent IEEE citations matching your bibliography. Continue applying this professional layout, ensuring full mathematical derivations and supporting calculations are explicitly presented within the main text or appendices.
